text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The High Court in Harare has stopped the municipality in Chinhoyi town from dismissing workers who recently went on strike and from hiring replacements.
- In recognition of Zimbabwe's efforts to bring financial discipline into its economy the African Development Bank has committed Z$2.6 billion for social and economic projects.

- The United States government has reassured African leaders who were attending last week's African/African-American summit that President Bill Clinton's administration will not marginalise the continent like previous U.S. leaders.
